identity.name: IZMO LIMITED
identity.industry: Automotive Retail Software + Semiconductor / Silicon-Photonics Packaging (dual-engine: legacy SaaS funding a deep-tech packaging build-out)

summary.oneLiner: IZMO printed its highest-ever quarter (Q4 revenue INR 109.16 cr, +82.5% YoY) and a record FY26 (INR 284.88 cr, +26.8%), but the headline jump is partly inflated by a one-time low-margin "special project" pass-through (other-expense spiked ~5x to ~INR 69 cr), so Q4 is not a clean run-rate. The real story is the pivot from a stable-but-slow automotive-SaaS base into deep-tech semiconductor packaging via izmomicro — the only Indian player in silicon-photonics packaging and 3D/stacked-die advanced packaging — which is targeting ~INR 50 cr revenue in FY27 (from ~INR 18–19 cr FY26) and INR 1,200–1,500 cr in ~5 years, funded by an in-process ~INR 150 cr (part of a ~INR 300 cr) equity-cum-debt raise. Execution and the capacity/fundraise are the swing factors.

> One-offs to strip out: the Q4 "special project" pass-through revenue + the matching ~INR 69 cr other-expense spike — both non-recurring; management explicitly says Q4 won't fully sustain but expects "close to this level" as izmomicro ramps. Margin was a conscious trade-off ("we didn't really care about the margin... build up the top line").
guidance (critical — verify next quarter:
- **Revenue growth FY27:** overall company growth above FY26; targeting 20–25%, "will try for highest possible" but won't promise 30–35%.
- **izmomicro FY27:** ~INR 45–50 cr revenue (from ~INR 18–19 cr FY26); FY28 "substantially more"; ~5-yr vision INR 1,200–1,500 cr.
- **Margin:** blended EBITDA 20–25% in FY27, 30%+ in FY28 (driven by izmomicro mix + new plant); new packaging plant EBITDA ~35%+. Gross margin on packaging 50–60%, silicon-photonics higher.
- **Other expenses:** ~INR 69 cr Q4 spike to come DOWN next quarter.
- **Capex / fundraise:** raising ~INR 150 cr (~INR 125 cr capex + ~INR 25 cr working capital), part of previously-disclosed ~INR 300 cr external funding; equity-cum-debt mix not yet frozen — clarity expected in 30–45 days. Plant implementation ~1 year → revenue from Q2/Q3 FY28; ramp 20% → 50–60% → 80–90% phased.
- **Capacity:** current facility supports ~INR 150 cr top-line; post-expansion addressable ~INR 1,200 cr.
- **izmomicro mix:** ~80% advanced packaging / ~20% silicon-photonics; top vertical = Defence (then automotive, space). Alcyon/CCRAFT/IIT-Madras collaborations to contribute revenue "in the current year" (FY27).
order book & pipeline:
- izmomicro order book ~INR 40 cr (one mention "INR 45 cr"); pipeline ~INR 100 cr at various discussion stages; INR 100 cr+ opportunity visibility over next 12–18 months. Current ~INR 40 cr book executes in ~9 months. Project timelines vary widely (3 months to 2 years — e.g. ISRO camera-payload space packaging is a ~2-yr project).
- Repeat-order traction: key clients moving work back from abroad to India ("can you do this, can you do this"), starting with one project → second → third. Validated customers from Automotive, Defence, Space — #1 by share = Indian Defence.
- Named "100-volt/high-temperature rotating motor" product: qualified through a detailed cycle, first batch in production for the customer.
- FrogData: flat for ~2 quarters (sluggish market) but resurgence in the last quarter with "very strong order pipeline"; Ford partnership added (FrogData on FordDirect's "The Shop"; preferred vendor for 2,200+ Ford dealers across 20+ countries).
segment / subsidiary detail:
- **izmostock:** world's largest automotive imagery platform; redesigned portal gaining traction (rental fleets, insurance, leasing, dealer groups); mainly subscription.
- **izmocars:** EU + US OEM/dealer digital marketing; Stellantis full European aftersales rollout completed; sustained US organic adds; Geronimo (UK) adding clients in Germany/Central Europe. Subscription + occasional one-off OEM projects (booked in our Q4 = OEMs' Q1).
- **FrogData:** US dealer fixed-ops decision-intelligence SaaS; >93% gross revenue retention; Ford/FordDirect tie-up; possible future separate listing/fundraise "at the right time."
- **izmomicro / izmo Microsystems:** advanced packaging (flip-chip, stacked-die/3D, QFN; only Indian player in 3D stacked-die) + silicon-photonics packaging (Aug-2025 breakthrough: 32-channel high-density platform, insertion loss <2 dB, up to 70 GHz — among a few globally; US/Spain/India lead in photonics); defence-electronics packaging (April-2026 → ongoing supply contracts); named photonic-IC packaging partner for MeitY-supported IIT-Madras silicon-photonics initiative; member of Silicon Saxony; collaborations with CCRAFT (foundry) + Alcyon Photonics (package design) — 3-way go-to-market.
- AI factory / own LLM infrastructure: in-house AI-based software development → cost efficiencies, faster dev.
growth verticals / optionality:
- **Silicon-photonics packaging into AI data centers:** TAM ~$30bn now → ~$80bn in a couple of years; core components of optical transceivers (e.g. 800G); >INR 3 lakh cr hyperscaler data-center capex announced for India; "copper is the limitation, everything moving to photonics." First data-center photonics deliverable expected in ~3 months (for a foreign company's India-based data center).
- **Defence/space packaging:** record INR 7.85 lakh cr defence budget + indigenisation mandate; ISRO camera-payload (space); Tesla space-orbiter data-center optionality (IZMO has space-packaging expertise if opportunity arises).
- **Quantum:** doing the packaging for IIT quantum chips (3 more chips over next 2 years) — packaging-only, not quantum design.
- **Government support:** ISM 1 & 2 (~INR 1 lakh cr allocation); DSIR R&D status unlocks grants/manufacturing incentives.
- **FrogData potential separate listing/fundraise** — deferred to a later milestone.
margins & cost dynamics:
- Q4 margin deliberately sacrificed for top-line/business build-up; izmomicro growth-phase costs expensed now while revenue scales (non-linear — costs flatten as revenue rises → margin accretion).
- Packaging gross margins 50–60% (silicon-photonics higher); new plant ~35%+ EBITDA → blended 30%+ by FY28.
- ~INR 69 cr other-expense was largely pass-through outsourced services on a special project (margin made on it, but optically dilutive); reverses next quarter.
- AI-driven cost-optimization programs supporting margins across the company.
capex / expansion (watch slippage):
- ~INR 125 cr capex (of ~INR 150 cr raise) for the new packaging plant; ~1 yr to implement → revenue from Q2/Q3 FY28; takes addressable top-line from ~INR 150 cr to ~INR 1,200 cr.
- 6-month delay in launching the capex/fundraise: management says it was firming up technology/machine choices; fundraise started "in earnest" only last month after freezing the technical plan. **Watch:** fundraise not yet closed — execution gated on it.
capital allocation:
- Funding the semiconductor build via external raise (~INR 150 cr now, part of ~INR 300 cr disclosed): equity-cum-debt, mix undecided (clarity in 30–45 days) — dilution risk to monitor.
- Legacy automotive-SaaS cash flows + 11 subsidiaries (~INR 50 cr profit) self-fund operations; cash-flow positive from operations despite stretched receivables.
- No dividend/buyback discussed.
risks & watch-items:
- **Q4 not a clean run-rate:** large one-time pass-through special project inflated both revenue and other-expense; sustainability of the ~INR 109 cr quarter unproven (mgmt hedged: "maybe not this quarter, maybe next").
- **Fundraise execution risk:** ~INR 300 cr raise not closed; equity dilution magnitude unknown; capex/scale-up entirely dependent on it.
- **Small-scale-vs-hyperscaler gap:** big international customers find IZMO "too small," giving only pilot orders until capacity expands — chicken-and-egg on scale.
- **FY26 PAT flat despite +27% revenue** — investment phase compresses profit; margin recovery is a guided expectation, not yet delivered.
- **Receivables stretch** (~129 cr, 100–110 days) on large slow-paying auto clients.
- **Audit/governance optics:** US subsidiary not audited (only tax-filed); investor flagged 11 unaudited-looking subs — mgmt explained thresholds but it's a watch-item.
- **FrogData** was flat 2 quarters — recovery only just started.
- **Execution complexity:** highly customized, long-cycle packaging projects (up to 2 yrs) → lumpy revenue recognition.
management quality / tone: - Sanjay Soni (MD) candid and confident; openly framed the Q4 margin sacrifice as deliberate and flagged the one-time other-expense (and accepted an investor's suggestion to footnote it). Articulate on the photonics/packaging value-chain (packaging = 8–10% of OSAT cost → 50% in advanced → 80% in silicon-photonics). Appropriately humble on competition ("anything is possible... but process technology, material science is not built overnight") and on scale limits. Slightly promotional on the INR 1,200–1,500 cr 5-yr vision and breadth of optionality (quantum, Tesla space orbiter, ISRO) — verify against the gated fundraise. Declined to give izmomicro Q4 loss figure / hard FY27 number (deferred to email/IR).
non-obvious takeaways:
- The equity story is bifurcating: a steady automotive-SaaS cash engine (izmostock/izmocars/FrogData, mostly subscription, >93% retention) quietly subsidizing a high-optionality semiconductor-packaging bet — IZMO is effectively a SaaS company re-rating into a deep-tech semicap name.
- "Only Indian player" in two niches: silicon-photonics packaging AND 3D/stacked-die advanced packaging — a genuine import-substitution + picks-and-shovels angle on India's AI-data-center and defence-electronics capex, but at sub-INR 20 cr current scale it is optionality, not yet a P&L driver.
- Capacity math is the key unlock: ~INR 150 cr current → ~INR 1,200 cr addressable post-expansion; the entire bull case hinges on closing the raise and the ~1-yr plant build (revenue only from FY28).
- The packaging-not-design positioning is the risk-mitigant: IZMO complements (not competes with) Marvell/big designers, so it claims it needs ~INR 100–150 cr, not $1bn — but it still hasn't made a data-center photonics breakthrough (first deliverable ~3 months out).
- Defence is the surprise #1 izmomicro vertical (ahead of automotive/space) with repeat contracts already — the highest-conviction near-term revenue line.

themes.title: Digital platforms, SaaS, payments & cybersecurity
themes.need: Digital-public-infrastructure scale, enterprise SaaS and a compliance/security upcycle drive a distinct platform cohort. PINELABS/NPST/CMSINFO on payments; AURIONPRO/NEWGEN/NUCLEUS/ROUTE/TANLA on banking/CPaaS software; EMUDHRA/META(544441)/AURIONPRO on digital-identity & cybersecurity; CAPILLARY/MAPMYINDIA/NAZARA on SaaS/geospatial/gaming. Q1FY27 anchored the payments leg: PAYTM's GMV grew 31% YoY (accelerating 23% -> 27% -> 31%) with merchant payments about 80% of the financial-services mix and 25-30 lakh device additions a year on a distribution-only lending model (no book, no FLDG); MOBIKWIK posted payments GMV of INR 52,400cr (+58% YoY), a 13th consecutive record quarter and India's largest wallet by GTV at ~20% share, against only ~INR 3,200cr of digital-credit GMV. OFSS adds the banking-software annuity, with RPO +17% YoY versus revenue +7% and licence-and-cloud revenue +13% at a 44% operating margin.
themes.driver: Deal/ARR additions; festive digital-payments TPV; merchant-device additions; RBI/regulatory compliance-driven security spend.

identity.name: IZMO LIMITED
identity.industry: Automotive Retail Software + Semiconductor / Silicon-Photonics Packaging (dual-engine: legacy SaaS funding a deep-tech packaging build-out)

hero.oneLiner: IZMO printed its highest-ever quarter (Q4 revenue INR 109.16 cr, +82.5% YoY) and a record FY26 (INR 284.88 cr, +26.8%), but the headline jump is partly inflated by a one-time low-margin "special project" pass-through (other-expense spiked ~5x to ~INR 69 cr), so Q4 is not a clean run-rate. The real story is the pivot from a stable-but-slow automotive-SaaS base into deep-tech semiconductor packaging via izmomicro — the only Indian player in silicon-photonics packaging and 3D/stacked-die advanced packaging — which is targeting ~INR 50 cr revenue in FY27 (from ~INR 18–19 cr FY26) and INR 1,200–1,500 cr in ~5 years, funded by an in-process ~INR 150 cr (part of a ~INR 300 cr) equity-cum-debt raise. Execution and the capacity/fundraise are the swing factors.
hero.industry: Automotive Retail Software + Semiconductor / Silicon-Photonics Packaging (dual-engine: legacy SaaS funding a deep-tech packaging build-out)

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body:
- **izmostock:** world's largest automotive imagery platform; redesigned portal gaining traction (rental fleets, insurance, leasing, dealer groups); mainly subscription.
- **izmocars:** EU + US OEM/dealer digital marketing; Stellantis full European aftersales rollout completed; sustained US organic adds; Geronimo (UK) adding clients in Germany/Central Europe. Subscription + occasional one-off OEM projects (booked in our Q4 = OEMs' Q1).
- **FrogData:** US dealer fixed-ops decision-intelligence SaaS; >93% gross revenue retention; Ford/FordDirect tie-up; possible future separate listing/fundraise "at the right time."
- **izmomicro / izmo Microsystems:** advanced packaging (flip-chip, stacked-die/3D, QFN; only Indian player in 3D stacked-die) + silicon-photonics packaging (Aug-2025 breakthrough: 32-channel high-density platform, insertion loss <2 dB, up to 70 GHz — among a few globally; US/Spain/India lead in photonics); defence-electronics packaging (April-2026 → ongoing supply contracts); named photonic-IC packaging partner for MeitY-supported IIT-Madras silicon-photonics initiative; member of Silicon Saxony; collaborations with CCRAFT (foundry) + Alcyon Photonics (package design) — 3-way go-to-market.
- AI factory / own LLM infrastructure: in-house AI-based software development → cost efficiencies, faster dev.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body:
- izmomicro order book ~INR 40 cr (one mention "INR 45 cr"); pipeline ~INR 100 cr at various discussion stages; INR 100 cr+ opportunity visibility over next 12–18 months. Current ~INR 40 cr book executes in ~9 months. Project timelines vary widely (3 months to 2 years — e.g. ISRO camera-payload space packaging is a ~2-yr project).
- Repeat-order traction: key clients moving work back from abroad to India ("can you do this, can you do this"), starting with one project → second → third. Validated customers from Automotive, Defence, Space — #1 by share = Indian Defence.
- Named "100-volt/high-temperature rotating motor" product: qualified through a detailed cycle, first batch in production for the customer.
- FrogData: flat for ~2 quarters (sluggish market) but resurgence in the last quarter with "very strong order pipeline"; Ford partnership added (FrogData on FordDirect's "The Shop"; preferred vendor for 2,200+ Ford dealers across 20+ countries).

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)
guidance.body:
- **Revenue growth FY27:** overall company growth above FY26; targeting 20–25%, "will try for highest possible" but won't promise 30–35%.
- **izmomicro FY27:** ~INR 45–50 cr revenue (from ~INR 18–19 cr FY26); FY28 "substantially more"; ~5-yr vision INR 1,200–1,500 cr.
- **Margin:** blended EBITDA 20–25% in FY27, 30%+ in FY28 (driven by izmomicro mix + new plant); new packaging plant EBITDA ~35%+. Gross margin on packaging 50–60%, silicon-photonics higher.
- **Other expenses:** ~INR 69 cr Q4 spike to come DOWN next quarter.
- **Capex / fundraise:** raising ~INR 150 cr (~INR 125 cr capex + ~INR 25 cr working capital), part of previously-disclosed ~INR 300 cr external funding; equity-cum-debt mix not yet frozen — clarity expected in 30–45 days. Plant implementation ~1 year → revenue from Q2/Q3 FY28; ramp 20% → 50–60% → 80–90% phased.
- **Capacity:** current facility supports ~INR 150 cr top-line; post-expansion addressable ~INR 1,200 cr.
- **izmomicro mix:** ~80% advanced packaging / ~20% silicon-photonics; top vertical = Defence (then automotive, space). Alcyon/CCRAFT/IIT-Madras collaborations to contribute revenue "in the current year" (FY27).

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **Silicon-photonics packaging into AI data centers:** TAM ~$30bn now → ~$80bn in a couple of years; core components of optical transceivers (e.g. 800G); >INR 3 lakh cr hyperscaler data-center capex announced for India; "copper is the limitation, everything moving to photonics." First data-center photonics deliverable expected in ~3 months (for a foreign company's India-based data center).
- **Defence/space packaging:** record INR 7.85 lakh cr defence budget + indigenisation mandate; ISRO camera-payload (space); Tesla space-orbiter data-center optionality (IZMO has space-packaging expertise if opportunity arises).
- **Quantum:** doing the packaging for IIT quantum chips (3 more chips over next 2 years) — packaging-only, not quantum design.
- **Government support:** ISM 1 & 2 (~INR 1 lakh cr allocation); DSIR R&D status unlocks grants/manufacturing incentives.
- **FrogData potential separate listing/fundraise** — deferred to a later milestone.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- Q4 margin deliberately sacrificed for top-line/business build-up; izmomicro growth-phase costs expensed now while revenue scales (non-linear — costs flatten as revenue rises → margin accretion).
- Packaging gross margins 50–60% (silicon-photonics higher); new plant ~35%+ EBITDA → blended 30%+ by FY28.
- ~INR 69 cr other-expense was largely pass-through outsourced services on a special project (margin made on it, but optically dilutive); reverses next quarter.
- AI-driven cost-optimization programs supporting margins across the company.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Funding the semiconductor build via external raise (~INR 150 cr now, part of ~INR 300 cr disclosed): equity-cum-debt, mix undecided (clarity in 30–45 days) — dilution risk to monitor.
- Legacy automotive-SaaS cash flows + 11 subsidiaries (~INR 50 cr profit) self-fund operations; cash-flow positive from operations despite stretched receivables.
- No dividend/buyback discussed.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: - Sanjay Soni (MD) candid and confident; openly framed the Q4 margin sacrifice as deliberate and flagged the one-time other-expense (and accepted an investor's suggestion to footnote it). Articulate on the photonics/packaging value-chain (packaging = 8–10% of OSAT cost → 50% in advanced → 80% in silicon-photonics). Appropriately humble on competition ("anything is possible... but process technology, material science is not built overnight") and on scale limits. Slightly promotional on the INR 1,200–1,500 cr 5-yr vision and breadth of optionality (quantum, Tesla space orbiter, ISRO) — verify against the gated fundraise. Declined to give izmomicro Q4 loss figure / hard FY27 number (deferred to email/IR).

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Q4 not a clean run-rate:** large one-time pass-through special project inflated both revenue and other-expense; sustainability of the ~INR 109 cr quarter unproven (mgmt hedged: "maybe not this quarter, maybe next").
- **Fundraise execution risk:** ~INR 300 cr raise not closed; equity dilution magnitude unknown; capex/scale-up entirely dependent on it.
- **Small-scale-vs-hyperscaler gap:** big international customers find IZMO "too small," giving only pilot orders until capacity expands — chicken-and-egg on scale.
- **FY26 PAT flat despite +27% revenue** — investment phase compresses profit; margin recovery is a guided expectation, not yet delivered.
- **Receivables stretch** (~129 cr, 100–110 days) on large slow-paying auto clients.
- **Audit/governance optics:** US subsidiary not audited (only tax-filed); investor flagged 11 unaudited-looking subs — mgmt explained thresholds but it's a watch-item.
- **FrogData** was flat 2 quarters — recovery only just started.
- **Execution complexity:** highly customized, long-cycle packaging projects (up to 2 yrs) → lumpy revenue recognition.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- The equity story is bifurcating: a steady automotive-SaaS cash engine (izmostock/izmocars/FrogData, mostly subscription, >93% retention) quietly subsidizing a high-optionality semiconductor-packaging bet — IZMO is effectively a SaaS company re-rating into a deep-tech semicap name.
- "Only Indian player" in two niches: silicon-photonics packaging AND 3D/stacked-die advanced packaging — a genuine import-substitution + picks-and-shovels angle on India's AI-data-center and defence-electronics capex, but at sub-INR 20 cr current scale it is optionality, not yet a P&L driver.
- Capacity math is the key unlock: ~INR 150 cr current → ~INR 1,200 cr addressable post-expansion; the entire bull case hinges on closing the raise and the ~1-yr plant build (revenue only from FY28).
- The packaging-not-design positioning is the risk-mitigant: IZMO complements (not competes with) Marvell/big designers, so it claims it needs ~INR 100–150 cr, not $1bn — but it still hasn't made a data-center photonics breakthrough (first deliverable ~3 months out).
- Defence is the surprise #1 izmomicro vertical (ahead of automotive/space) with repeat contracts already — the highest-conviction near-term revenue line.
